title: Binary value of a Boolean list
statement: For a list of Booleans, define its value recursively by assigning the empty list value $0$ and assigning a list with first bit $b$ and remaining list $bs$ the value $(1	ext{ if }b	ext{ is true, otherwise }0)+2$ times the value of $bs$. Thus the first list element is the least significant bit.
